notes.title: Stream or Die! Demo
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm excited to announce that there is a demo ready to play on our Steam store page!

Also be sure to check out our new Gameplay Video!

[previewyoutube=Uo8O7EdrFjM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Please let me know what you think in the discussion forum, and --- Happy Streaming!

- Echo

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
